entries.text: Heavy block break: Liaos, Iron Reapers.
Poison, exotics, debuffs units overall like Rattan, Zykalian, etc.
"Pikes in general — you soak dmg for the team and your team cav can enter front if you are baiting enemy pike into hitting you" (per Amya).

steps.text: Front-line for your team, protect the DPS.
Keep cover-commander active but think about X-moving in to be sure to take the frontline. You are fixing the front-lane — don't bait your DPS units and don't get flanked.
